svg.title: A neck closes only at infinite time
svg.desc: Su–Tsai–Wood construction: four signed generating profiles of an equal-angle Lawlor neck in complex dimension three, at model times zero, one, five and infinity. All four have the same spatial scale. An inset magnifies the neck to unit waist. The global compact flow is a connected sum of two three-tori; the planar profiles are not the full submanifold or a simulated mean curvature flow.

g.text: A neck closes only at infinite time
Su–Tsai–Wood · m = 3 in C³ / Γ · exact local profiles, leading-order time model
The gold marks are opposite representatives of the waist sphere S².
Signed profiles ±γ represent one connected 3-dimensional neck, not two separate components.
Each γ generates the sphere {γω : ω ∈ S²}.
Blue and ochre mark the two sides of the neck.
Their tangent planes stay fixed as ε decreases.
meeting at one point as t → ∞
The full flow is not explicit. Changing the scale of a minimal neck alone does not solve MCF.
Source: arXiv:2401.02228v3, §2.3, equation (1.1), and Proposition 9.5. Original profile drawing.
